---
title: "From Startup Chaos to Smart Deal Flow"
subtitle: "Using AI to Help VCs Pick Better Companies"
author: "Eesha Jagdhane"
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: simple
    transition: fade
    background-transition: fade
    slide-number: true
    progress: true
    center: false
    title-slide: false
    ratio: "16:9"
    width: 1600
    height: 900
    auto-stretch: false
    margin: 0.08
    footer: "MGTA 495 · Marketing Analytics"
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@700;900&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

<style>
:root {
  --paper: #f0ece4;         /* website background */
  --ink: #2e2825;           /* website text */
  --ink-soft: #6b6560;      /* softer text */
  --muted: #8a8278;         /* muted label text */
  --panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
  --panel-2: rgba(232, 227, 218, 0.7);  /* #e8e3da */
  --border: rgba(46, 40, 37, 0.18);
  --shadow: rgba(46, 40, 37, 0.12);

  /* restrained VC accents (keep premium, not neon) */
  --blue: #2f81f7;
  --green: #2da44e;
  --purple: #8250df;
  --rose: #7a3b35;          /* website accent */
}

.reveal {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.reveal .slides {
  text-align: left;
}

.reveal .slides section {
  background: radial-gradient(1100px 600px at 20% 10%, rgba(47, 129, 247, 0.09), rgba(47, 129, 247, 0) 60%),
              radial-gradient(900px 520px at 92% 22%, rgba(130, 80, 223, 0.10), rgba(130, 80, 223, 0) 58%),
              linear-gradient(180deg, #f6f2ec 0%, var(--paper) 40%, #efe9e0 100%);
  padding: 1.5rem 2.4rem 1.35rem !important;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  height: 100% !important;
}

/* All content below the slide title stays inside the frame */
.reveal .slide-body {
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  font-size: 0.72em;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.reveal h1, .reveal h2, .reveal h3 {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-transform: none;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  line-height: 1.05;
}

.reveal h1 { font-size: 2.5em; margin-bottom: 0.4em; }
.reveal h2 {
  font-size: 2em;
  margin-bottom: 0.4em;
  padding-bottom: 0.28em;
  border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(122, 59, 53, 0.25);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.reveal h3 {
  font-size: 0.78em;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--rose);
  margin: 0.55em 0 0.35em;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.reveal .slide-intro {
  font-size: 0.95em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  margin: 0 0 0.75em;
  max-width: 100%;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.reveal .metric {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--blue);
}
.reveal .metric-sm {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--blue);
}
.reveal .two-col-slide {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  margin-top: 0.5em;
}

.reveal .slide-body p,
.reveal .slide-body li {
  font-size: 1em;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.reveal .slide-body ul {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0.45em 0 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.reveal .slide-body ul li {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 1.15em;
  margin-bottom: 0.35em;
}

.reveal .slide-body ul li::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0.45em;
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--blue);
}

.reveal .subtitle-line {
  font-size: 0.88em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-weight: 300;
  margin-bottom: 1em;
  max-width: 100%;
}
.reveal .intro-hero {
  margin-top: 0.35em;
  font-size: 0.78em;
}
.reveal .intro-title {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-size: 2.6em;
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1.05;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 0.35em;
  max-width: 100%;
}

.reveal .callout {
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--blue);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
  margin: 0.55em 0;
  font-size: 0.92em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-style: normal;
  line-height: 1.4;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px var(--shadow);
  max-width: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  white-space: normal;
  word-wrap: break-word;
  overflow-wrap: break-word;
  display: block;
}

.reveal .callout-accent {
  border-left-color: var(--green);
}

.reveal .callout-purple {
  border-left-color: var(--purple);
}

.reveal .flow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.28rem;
  margin: 0.5em 0;
  max-width: 100%;
}

.reveal .flow-step {
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.55rem;
  font-size: 0.82em;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: normal;
  max-width: 9.5rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  text-align: center;
}

.reveal .flow-step.muted-step {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  border-color: var(--muted);
}

.reveal .flow-step.highlight {
  border-color: var(--blue);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(88, 166, 255, 0.15);
}

.reveal .flow-step.highlight-green {
  border-color: var(--green);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(63, 185, 80, 0.15);
}

.reveal .flow-step.highlight-purple {
  border-color: var(--purple);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(188, 140, 255, 0.15);
}

.reveal .flow-arrow {
  color: rgba(46, 40, 37, 0.45);
  font-size: 0.75em;
  font-weight: 300;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.reveal .pain-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  margin-top: 0.45em;
}

.reveal .pain-tag {
  font-size: 0.78em;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  background: var(--panel-2);
}

.reveal .pain-tag.bad {
  border-color: rgba(168, 50, 40, 0.35);
  color: rgba(168, 50, 40, 0.95);
}

.reveal .pain-tag.good {
  border-color: var(--green);
  color: var(--green);
}

.reveal .segment-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-top: 0.35em;
}
.reveal .segment-grid.compact .segment-card {
  padding: 0.5rem 0.7rem;
  font-size: 0.65em;
}

.reveal .segment-card {
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem;
  font-size: 0.88em;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.reveal .segment-card span {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  margin-top: 0.15em;
}

.reveal .segment-card.gem {
  border-color: var(--green);
}

.reveal .segment-card.low {
  border-color: rgba(46, 40, 37, 0.14);
  opacity: 0.75;
}

.reveal .driver-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  margin-top: 0.35em;
}
.reveal .driver-list.compact .driver-item {
  font-size: 0.72em;
}

.reveal .driver-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  font-size: 0.88em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.reveal .driver-bar {
  flex: 1;
  height: 4px;
  background: rgba(46, 40, 37, 0.12);
  border-radius: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.reveal .driver-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue), var(--purple));
}

.reveal .impact-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  margin: 0.5em 0;
}

.reveal .impact-item {
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem;
  font-size: 0.82em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.reveal .impact-item strong {
  display: block;
  color: var(--green);
  font-size: 1em;
  margin-bottom: 0.15em;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.reveal .closing {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(47,129,247,0.10), rgba(130,80,223,0.10));
  border: 1px solid rgba(46, 40, 37, 0.16);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
  margin-top: 0.5em;
  font-size: 0.9em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  line-height: 1.4;
  max-width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  white-space: normal;
  word-wrap: break-word;
  overflow-wrap: break-word;
}

.reveal .hero-stat {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-size: 2.4em;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--blue);
  line-height: 1;
  margin: 0.2em 0 0.05em;
  display: inline-block;
}

.reveal .hero-stat-label {
  font-size: 0.88em;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  margin-bottom: 0.45em;
}

.reveal .slide-footer-note {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 1.2rem;
  right: 3rem;
  font-size: 0.55em;
  color: var(--muted);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.reveal .progress { color: var(--blue); }
.reveal .slide-number { color: rgba(46, 40, 37, 0.55); font-size: 0.55em; }
</style>

## Introduction

<div class="intro-hero">
  <div class="intro-title">From Startup Chaos to Smart Deal Flow</div>
  <div class="subtitle-line">Using AI to Help VCs Pick Better Companies</div>
  <p class="slide-intro">Marketing analytics applied to venture capital — turning messy deal flow into smarter, prioritized investment decisions.</p>
</div>

## The Problem

<div class="slide-body">

<p class="slide-intro">VCs review thousands of startups, but partner time and attention are limited.</p>

<div class="hero-stat">20,000+</div>
<div class="hero-stat-label">startups in the pipeline</div>

<div class="callout">
Imagine Shark Tank, but with <span class="metric-sm">20,000</span> startups in a spreadsheet.
</div>

- VCs review thousands of pitches every year
- Partner time is the scarcest resource
- Most deals never get a real look
- Great companies get lost in the noise

</div>

## Before AI

<div class="slide-body">

<p class="slide-intro">The traditional process is manual, inconsistent, and hard to scale.</p>

<div class="flow">
  <div class="flow-step">CRM Data</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step">Spreadsheets</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step">Manual Research</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step">PitchBook / Harmonic</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step muted-step">Gut Feeling</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step muted-step">Partner Review</div>
</div>

<div class="pain-tags">
  <div class="pain-tag bad">Slow</div>
  <div class="pain-tag bad">Inconsistent</div>
  <div class="pain-tag bad">Hard to Scale</div>
  <div class="pain-tag bad">Data Silos</div>
</div>

<div class="callout callout-accent">
Every analyst does it differently. High-potential startups slip through when there isn't enough time to research them all.
</div>

</div>

## AI-Assisted Deal Flow

<div class="slide-body">

<p class="slide-intro">AI gives deal flow a brain — unified data, faster insight, and prioritized review.</p>

<div class="flow">
  <div class="flow-step">CRM + Harmonic + PitchBook</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step highlight">AI Summaries</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step highlight">Investment Signals</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step highlight-green">Relevance Scoring</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step highlight-purple">Prioritized Deal Flow</div>
</div>

- External data unified into one view
- AI distills company narratives in seconds
- Signals surface thesis-fit opportunities automatically
- Partners review the <strong class="metric-sm">best</strong> deals first — not just the loudest

<div class="callout callout-purple">
AI doesn't replace judgment — it front-loads intelligence so investors spend time where it matters.
</div>

</div>

## Marketing Analytics

<div class="slide-body">

<p class="slide-intro">How course concepts map to venture deal selection.</p>

<div class="two-col-slide">
  <div>
    <h3>Segmentation (Unsupervised ML)</h3>
    <p class="slide-intro">Segment startups, not customers.</p>
    <div class="segment-grid compact">
      <div class="segment-card">High-Growth AI<span>Headcount & funding velocity</span></div>
      <div class="segment-card">Recently Funded<span>Fresh capital, momentum</span></div>
      <div class="segment-card">Investor-Backed<span>Top-tier syndicate signals</span></div>
      <div class="segment-card gem">Hidden Gems<span>Strong signals, low visibility</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div>
    <h3>Key Drivers (Supervised ML)</h3>
    <p class="slide-intro">What drives a high relevance score?</p>
    <div class="driver-list compact">
      <div class="driver-item">Thesis Fit <div class="driver-bar"><div class="driver-bar-fill" style="width:92%"></div></div></div>
      <div class="driver-item">Headcount Growth <div class="driver-bar"><div class="driver-bar-fill" style="width:78%"></div></div></div>
      <div class="driver-item">Recent Funding <div class="driver-bar"><div class="driver-bar-fill" style="width:71%"></div></div></div>
      <div class="driver-item">Investor Quality <div class="driver-bar"><div class="driver-bar-fill" style="width:68%"></div></div></div>
      <div class="driver-item">Founder / Team <div class="driver-bar"><div class="driver-bar-fill" style="width:65%"></div></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

</div>

## Impact

<div class="slide-body">

<p class="slide-intro">The goal is not to replace investors — it's to help them focus.</p>

<div class="impact-grid">
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Less Manual Screening</strong>Automate the first pass across thousands of companies</div>
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Faster Review</strong>AI summaries cut research time from hours to minutes</div>
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Consistent Scoring</strong>Every deal evaluated with the same framework</div>
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Better Data Use</strong>Harmonic, PitchBook, and CRM signals unified</div>
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Easier Prioritization</strong>Ranked deal flow replaces gut-only triage</div>
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Hidden Gems Found</strong>Strong startups surface before competitors notice</div>
</div>

<div class="closing">
This project applies marketing analytics thinking to venture capital: using AI, segmentation, and relevance scoring to turn messy deal flow into smarter investment decisions.
</div>

</div>
